svg.title: Icon Normalizer — actual PNG previews
svg.desc: Original backend PNGs on equal canvases, without AI redrawing. The algorithm normalizes the longest visible core edge relative to the canvas, not perceptual area. Standard preset 88 percent plus or minus 2 percentage points, inner logo 72 percent.
